reasoning_trace: The visual inspection reveals a smooth, clean, rigid plastic hand sanitizer bottle. The gecko gripper requires clean, smooth, nonporous surfaces, which matches the bottle's sidewall material characteristics. Because gecko adhesion leverages van der Waals forces and high conforming contact on flat surfaces, the required normal pre-load force to establish contact and support a 1000 mL liquid container is low compared to friction-only grippers. Factoring in the moderate mass and favorable surface material compatibility, a conservative low normal force of 1.5 N is predicted to ensure stable pre-load without crushing the plastic container.
